task: identify genuine delivery stops from courier vehicle GPS trajectories
note: Abstract states SMOTE applied exclusively to the training partition (FT fields na, abstract only). FNR and FPR coded other. Classifier input is five engineered stop features, so tabular. Logistics could also be business.

task: classify concrete compressive strength class from mix data
note: Regression recast as classes. Abstract says stratified split, then training set made perfectly balanced by SMOTE (FT na). Learner is dominance-based rough set rules (other). Abstract names no measure, only a confusion matrix.

task: predict whether express parcels contain counterfeit cigarettes
note: SMOTE-ENN is the stated approach but compared only before/after, not with other resampling (rule B: application). Law-enforcement crime prediction coded social. Classifiers and measures unnamed in abstract (na). Features from segmented Chinese parcel text.

task: predict DNA-binding residues in protein sequences
note: ADASYN oversampling plus bootstrap undersampling feeding an ensemble of CNNs; compared only with other predictors, not other resampling (rule B: application). Protein sequence features (PSSM, one-hot) coded modality other. Ten-fold CV.

task: classify network intrusions on KDD Cup 99 and NSL-KDD
note: GAN augmentation for an MLP and a VAE-GAN hybrid for imbalance, no stated change to the generators (B2: application). GNN and tabular transformer coded deep-net. False alarm rate coded other.

task: predict five-year survivability of patients with two primary cancers
note: Taiwan nationwide cancer registry, 7,845 patients. Abstract implies models with and without SMOTE compared (FT field na). Bayesian network coded other.

task: classify sentiment of streamed customer reviews under concept drift
note: DistilBERT embeddings, autoencoder compression and SMOTE in a drift-adaptive stream pipeline; 80:20 split. Customer-review sentiment coded social (text); business also possible.

task: predict defective software modules from code metrics
note: PSO feature selection, random undersampling plus SMOTE, bagged naive Bayes; compared only with plain naive Bayes, not other resampling (rule B: application). NASA MDP data sets.

task: predict defaulted debts from Egyptian social insurance records
note: Compares several existing resampling methods within a debt-default application; only SOUP is named (coded other), the others are unnamed. Micro-averaged precision and recall. Debtors may be firms rather than persons.

task: predict DNase I hypersensitive sites in plant genomes
note: No abstract; title only. Title shows a domain predictor (Dempster-Shafer evidence fusion), no own resampling; resampling itself not visible, so resampler na and yes rests on the screen's E1 placement.

task: classify flood events in Samarinda from weather records
note: Indonesian title, English abstract. PSO-optimised random forest with chi-square selection and SMOTE; 5-fold CV on 1,095 BMKG/BPBD records.

task: detect fraudulent credit card transactions
note: LSTM with SMOTE on the CCFD card data set; KNN, naive Bayes and CNN only as baselines. ROC curve mapped to ROC-AUC. Transaction-level decision, so stakes other.

task: classify entities into institutional sectors
note: No abstract; title only (SSRN). Title shows a domain classifier (likely official or financial statistics), no own resampling; resampling not visible, so yes rests on the screen's E1 placement. Modality, learner, measures unknown.

task: predict student final results and identify students at risk of failing
note: Open University (OULAD) data. LASSO-RF proposed, SVC and LASSO-DNN baselines; results on balanced and unbalanced data (FT na). XGBoost and LASSO appear to serve feature selection, so boosting not listed.

task: screen for early type 2 diabetes onset from clinical and lifestyle data
note: 'Adaptive synthetic oversampling algorithms' read as ADASYN. CNN, autoencoder, TIPNet (plus unnamed ensembles). 'Independent testing' not said to use another source, so internal; 10-fold CV.

task: predict vancomycin-resistant enterococci infections in hospital patients
note: PhD thesis (Spanish/English abstract); only the VRE prediction rule uses resampling: unnamed 'oversampling' (resampler na), FCBF, LASSO, 30-month sliding window. Sliding window may imply temporal validation; module built into WASPSS, no results from use.

task: predict neonatal mortality from Kenya 2022 DHS survey data
note: KDHS 2022 survey data; CatBoost best among unnamed ensemble learners. Split protocol not given in abstract.

task: classify quiz questions by difficulty level
note: Telkom University data warehouse course questions; NB and SVM accuracy before and after SMOTE (FT na). Abstract does not say whether question text or response statistics are the input, so modality na.

task: predict polygonal wear degree of high-speed train wheels for maintenance priority
note: SMOTE-NC on mixed-feature wheel maintenance records (2016-2017); autoencoder features fed to a Bayesian-optimised SVM. Abstract names no measure. Railway maintenance coded industry; transport also fits.

task: detect corn diseases from plant images
note: Six pretrained CNNs (Xception, ResNet50, VGG16, EfficientNetB0, MobileNet, InceptionV3) with SMOTE on image data; space of SMOTE not stated. Abstract names no measure.

task: classify phases of high-entropy alloys
note: Materials science (coded other). LightGBM with GA feature selection; unnamed 'oversampling' (resampler na) used together with cost-sensitive learning for the BCC+FCC class. Ten-fold CV.

task: classify OS family, vendor and type of IP-connected devices
note: Nmap OS database; six classical and five DNN models, SMOTE and ADASYN explored. Three classical models unnamed. Asset management and security use; software (IT operations) also possible.

task: detect children at risk of Chinese handwriting difficulties
note: 300 children (39 at risk); five classifiers compared, SMOTE then applied to SVM. Tablet handwriting-process features treated as tabular. Domain could be medicine (clinical screening) rather than education.

task: classify off-body UWB channel links as LOS, PNLOS or NLOS
note: Wireless localisation (coded other). Multiclass SVM with SMOTE on two channel features; localisation error in cm coded other. 'Performance in different environment' read as external; unclear whether the classifier itself was retested there.

task: detect coronary artery disease from clinical and work-related features
note: Contribution is a hybrid feature selection (2HFS); SMOTE and ADASYN for imbalance. Approach re-applied to Hungarian, Long Beach VA and Z-Alizadeh Sani data, apparently each evaluated on its own, so internal.

task: classify Alzheimer's disease stage from brain MRI images
note: 6,400 MRI images; oversampling type not named (resampler na). ResNet18, ShuffleNet V2 and an own CNN with and without oversampling. Abstract says data 'previously gone through oversampling', which may mean before the split (FT na).

task: classify water coverage ratio in PEM fuel cell channels from images
note: Transparent PEMFC images in six water-coverage classes; random over- and undersampling. Fully connected DNN (4-41-64-120-99-6) tuned by GA; the 4-node input suggests image-derived features. Train and test accuracy reported.

task: classify network traffic into MITRE ATT&CK tactic classes
note: UWF-ZeekDataFall22 Zeek logs; one-vs-one and one-vs-all multiclass SVM with SMOTE.

task: detect and grade diabetic retinopathy from fundus images
note: Paper calls rotating, scaling and translating images 'SMOTE'; coded SMOTE as named. Two-stage training, no change to generation (application). Tested on five public DR databases; training source not stated, so external is tentative.

task: detect fraudulent credit card transactions
note: SMOTE plus ENN with a deep neural network on the European card benchmark; no comparison with other resampling stated (rule B: application).

task: detect fake news from text
note: Existing samplers in Bi-VAE latent space, compared only with imbalanced baseline and unnamed SOTA (rule B: application). Oversampling and hybrid methods unnamed. Abstract states a separate balanced test set (test_balanced FT, na).

task: predict customer response for precision marketing in omni-channel retail
note: Oversampling strategies and the response-model learner are not named (na). Case study on one Rabat retailer's data, not a deployment with results from use.

task: predict defect-prone software modules
note: Eleven classifiers on twelve defect data sets with four nature-inspired feature selectors and SHAP; only the best (gradient boosting variants, CatBoost, decision tree) are named.

task: diagnose coronary artery disease from clinical data
note: Z-Alizadeh Sani data; extra-trees classifier (coded forest) with XGBoost, KNN and SVM comparators; grid-search tuning.

task: classify DDoS attack types in network traffic
note: UNSW-NB15; effect of random oversampling on four learners with macro-averaged measures; SMOTE and ADASYN named only as rejected alternatives.

task: detect heart disease
note: SMOTE then NB, DT and homogeneous/heterogeneous ensembles; AdaBoost-random forest best; k-fold CV.

task: predict vector-borne diseases from environmental and clinical data
note: Oversampling techniques not named (resampler na). K-means clustering used as a classifier (coded other). Unit of prediction not explicit; clinical variables suggest patients, hence individual.

task: classify sentiment of tweets about the president's performance
note: Indonesian tweets, TF-IDF features, SMOTE; SVM, XGBoost and AdaBoost tuned with GridSearchCV.

task: predict three-class default risk of microcredit borrowers
note: SMOTE with homogeneous and heterogeneous ensembles; best Consolidated Trees Construction with Rotation Forest. Borrowers are retail, micro and small enterprises. Abstract names no measure ('an additional set of metrics').

task: predict crime category of incidents in Montreal
note: Montreal crime data 2015-2023, SMOTE-ENN. XGBoost put in a Flask web application, but no results from use, so not deployed.

task: classify diabetes from demographic and clinical attributes
note: Kaggle diabetes data (~100,000 records). Abstract lists SMOTE-Tomek in preprocessing before the 80:20 split, yet accuracy 97% with recall 72% implies an imbalanced test set. FT fields na (abstract only).

task: predict type 2 diabetes from clinical measurements
note: Pima Indians Diabetes Database; tSNE reduction and SMOTE, then the proposed convolutional graph LSTM (CGLSTM), compared with existing approaches.

task: estimate associations between crash attributes and crash-type involvement by driver age
note: Inferential use: logistic-regression odds ratios estimated after SMOTE plus ENN on Shenzhen police crash data 2014-2016. Odds ratios coded other; no predictive evaluation reported, so validation nr.

task: predict wildfire occurrences by district and land-use category
note: Four Portuguese districts; historical fire and meteorological data. SMOTE raised recall at a cost in precision (FT fields na).

task: detect fraud and identity theft in open banking transactions
note: System paper (REST API, OAuth2, encryption, MLOps) with XGBoost and random forest after SMOTE. Data source not described; 'real-world settings' claimed without results from use.

task: classify gender of celebrity cartoon face images
note: IIIT-CFW cartoon faces; SIFT, FFT, DCT and FaceNet features with conventional classifiers, random forest on FaceNet features recommended. Other classifiers unnamed. Domain coded other.

task: extract diagnostic rules for aero-engine oil monitoring faults
note: Contribution is rule extraction from support vector clustering; SMOTE resamples fault samples. UCI benchmarks plus aero-engine oil monitoring application (aviation, transport also possible). Abstract names no measure.

task: classify policyholders into low, medium or high insurance risk
note: System description (AIRIS-X): XGBoost with SMOTE, SHAP, periodic retraining, chatbot. No evaluation results or measures in the abstract; claims SMOTE improves performance and fairness.

task: classify whether subjects perform an episodic memory task from fMRI
note: ICA, then SMOTE, then convolution-GRU on independent component signals of a small fMRI memory data set; SVM, logistic regression, LDA and KNN as baselines. Cognitive neuroscience without patient decision coded bio.

task: predict telecom customer churn
note: Stacking (extra trees, RF, XGBoost, LightGBM; logistic meta-model). If positive-class metrics, accuracy 97.46, precision 97.26, F1 97.37 imply about 48% churners in the test set, suggesting a balanced test set (FT na).

task: classify network traffic into attack categories for smart grid security
note: ET-SMOTE: extra-trees after plain SMOTE, compared with benchmark classifiers only (rule B: application). NSL-KDD data; smart-grid framing, energy also possible.

task: predict defective software modules
note: Existing A-SUWO oversampler (clustering-based SMOTE-family, coded other-SMOTE-variant) before classifiers on NASA data; no comparison with other resampling in abstract (rule B: application). Other classifiers unnamed.
